scenarios.description: A contract uses the exact defined term "Index Component Requirements" and states that its meaning is the one defined in Section 2.2.
A contract says "Index Component Requirements" shall have the meaning as defined in Section 3.1 instead of Section 2.2.
A contract defines "Index Component Requirements" in Section 2.2, but also says that any plural or singular variant of the phrase is included unless the context requires otherwise.
A contract states that "Index Component Requirements" will have the meaning defined in Section 2.2 only after the agreement is signed, and before signing it has no defined meaning.
